verdicts.reason: A is just a shrunk, centred copy: the FIZZBANG! pill covers about a fifth of the banner width, and the SINCE 2026 badge is tiny and hard to read. Most of the canvas is enlarged halftone dots, so the brand is lost in the pattern. B gives the logo pill a confident size and reads left to right, but the pill sits tight against the left edge. The badge floats in the middle-right, away from the logo, and the right third is empty, so the layout is lopsided and needs work on spacing and grouping.
